propositions: rebar push.py performs stash operations in the tickets worktree, but git stash stack is shared across all repository worktrees, allowing stashes from other branches to be popped into the wrong worktree

a stash created on a source branch was popped into the tickets worktree, leaving unmerged index entries (.rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py) that stranded every ticket store write
git stash is a repository-global operation being used for worktree-local intent, violating the principle that the ticket store must be mutated only through rebar's event API
the _resolve_conflicted_pop regenerable-files assumption does not hold because foreign source files can appear in unmerged paths via stash conflicts
auto-heal of stranded index on foreign (non-tracked, non-ticket-shaped) paths prevents outages but does not remove the underlying cause of pollution from shared stash operations
